shared_elements: rows/registers of small emblems or symbols aligned horizontally
tall vertical monument surface divided into an upper symbolic zone and a lower zone of repeated linear signs (text-like bands)
small schematic figures/standards arranged in a row
justification: Both surfaces present a tall vertical field in which an upper zone carries a horizontal row (or several registers) of small schematic emblems — discs, crescent/horn forms, standard-like objects — above a lower zone given over to dense repeated linear sign-bands, a fairly specific compositional scheme of emblem-register-over-inscription. The main differences are that B's upper panel is an arched scene with recognisable standing human/divine figures flanking symbols on stands, whereas A's carvings are largely isolated emblems (a large disc, coiling and horned forms) distributed down the whole shaft without an enclosing arch or attendant figures.
